summary: AGL Private Credit Income Fund, a Delaware closed-end interval fund (SEC file 814-01782) operating as a private credit BDC-style vehicle, filed a Form 8-K reporting a September 4, 2026 third amendment to its Revolving Credit Agreement originally dated October 18, 2024, with Societe Generale as administrative agent, sole lead arranger and letter of credit issuer. The amendment extends the stated maturity from September 16, 2026 to September 3, 2027 and cuts pricing to 185 bps over the reference rate and 85 bps on reference rate loans, with an upfront fee of 0.25% per annum on committed and 0.125% on uncommitted lender amounts. This is a routine credit-facility repricing and extension, not a special situation; watch for any future fund-level liquidity, leverage, or NAV events rather than deal terms.
